items.headline: Sources: Rams' Puka Nacua out 4-5 months after knee surgery, will miss playoffs
items.description: Puka Nacua's recovery time from MCL surgery is considered to be four to five months, sources told ESPN, meaning he will miss the playoffs.

items.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua has MCL surgery, likely done for regular season
items.description: Rams WR Puka Nacua, who is serving a three-game suspension while on IR, had surgery on his MCL and likely will miss at least the rest of the regular season.
